fields.description: Issue features reporting and commentary on alleged bankruptcy-related racketeering and federal investigation activity; city financial shortages revealed by audits (including the recreation director’s office and city garage) and discussion of grand jury activity. Includes a column by the superintendent of Jackson Memorial Hospital on preventing automobile injuries and a full-page traffic safety campaign message. Covers local politics and gambling controversies involving bookmaking and horse racing, along with sports coverage (including a Miami Beach boxing decision). Also includes entertainment and society items, advertisements, and ongoing promotion/results for Miami Life’s “Most Attractive Working Girl” beauty contest (winner: Mrs. Lois-Haynes Walta).
